text:
Ava: Quick poll — the office bonsai needs a new home. Who volunteers to take it? Also: drop your best one-liner (office-appropriate). I’ll pick a winner and bring cookies :cookie:

Ben: I’ll take it! One-liner: 'I tried to adult today — it expired.' :joy:

Priya: Happy to water it twice/week. One-liner: 'My productivity is like Wi‑Fi — strongest near the snacks.'

Mateo: If snacks are involved I’m sold. One-liner: 'Turning coffee into code since 2019.'

Kelsey: I’ll adopt if it likes jazz. One-liner: 'I put the "pro" in procrastinate.' :sunglasses:

Jun: Can we get a plant adoption certificate? :raised_hands: One-liner: 'Meeting adjourned: I nap now.'

Nora: I’ll be backup waterer. One-liner: 'I follow-up on my follow-ups.'

Sam: Cookie prize = high stakes. One-liner: 'Ctrl+Z is my emotional support.'

OpsBot: Reminder: please add watering schedule to #office-ops calendar — https://calendar.example/office-bonsai

Ava: Awesome, thanks! I’ll PM the new owner for pick-up and bring cookies Friday. Vote for your favorite one-liner with :trophy: reaction on this thread.

Ben: :trophy: on Mateo's — that coffee line slaps.

Kelsey: :trophy: on Ben's too, both classics.

Priya: :trophy: on Jun's because nap agenda.

Jun: :thumbsup: thanks all — will confirm jazz playlist preferences via DM :notes:

Nora: Also, name suggestions? 'Branch Manager' is already winning in my head.

Sam: :laughing: 'Branch Manager' is brilliant.

Ava: Done — 'Branch Manager' it is unless the council objects. I’ll update the calendar and bring the cookies. :cookie:
